description: Search screen structural guardrails for implementation-ready Flutter design SSOT.

forbiddenSelectors.message: External Material Symbols font usage is forbidden in this HTML design repository.
Search utility pane must not become a detail preview pane.
Search screen must not inherit detail-screen summary-card markup.
The search utility pane is for history/filter/sort, not detail navigation CTA.
Empty detail placeholders are not part of the search screen contract.

forbiddenText: 検索すると履歴が最大 5 件まで残ります
ドロップダウン履歴 + bottom-sheet
single source of truth — all screen states for all devices and themes live in this one page

requiredSelectors.message: Inline verification report must remain present.
Search SSOT must declare the full 74-frame matrix for VRT/inline verification.
Search SSOT must declare 9 phone states and 7 states for the four utility-pane device classes.
Search visible history limit must remain aligned with the Flutter UI display contract of 5 items.
iPad portrait and iPad Split View must stay utility-pane two-pane; Split View must keep a 960x700 representative frame and a utility pane width of at least 300px.
Phone portrait idle states must use inline history instead of a focus-only dropdown.
Landscape nav rail must be app-shell scoped and available to all tabs.
Utility pane must remain history/filter/sort, not a detail preview.
iPhone landscape must keep the compact left-rail search workspace.
SearchTab axis must be represented by explicit target contracts while the VRT matrix stays at 74 frames.
Drug sort wire values must stay aligned with Flutter DrugSort.
Disease sort wire values must stay aligned with Flutter DiseaseSort.
Bottom navigation height must stay aligned with Flutter NavigationBarThemeData.height.
Visible target contract table must clarify that 74 frames are representative and SearchTab is a separate axis.
Target contract table must include the drug tab contract.
Target contract table must include the disease tab contract.
Flutter handoff must map the 74-frame matrix to implementation verification.
Flutter handoff must clarify inline history as the final idle-state contract.
